public.app-category.productivity
SlyOS reads your calendar only when you ask about your schedule and writes events only after a confirmed request.
SlyOS uses the camera when you open Look mode to identify, read, and remember what you point at.
SlyOS searches your contacts only when a prompt needs a person, phone number, or email address.
SlyOS can lock your brain behind Face ID so only you can read it.
SlyOS uses your location when you ask something about where you are, or ask it to share your location.
SlyOS uses the microphone only when you choose voice input or a voice workflow.
SlyOS saves a document or image to your photos only when you ask it to.
SlyOS reads photos you explicitly choose for Look, document, receipt, and memory workflows.
SlyOS reads and writes reminders only for reminder workflows you explicitly request.
SlyOS transcribes speech only after you tap the voice control.
